implementation.directoryBirthtime: Existing artifactPhysicalIdentity birthtimeMs semantics including WSL1 rules, not a new nanosecond precision claim
implementation.scope: Only original catalog/head directories are bound per backend instance; mutable leaves reacquire identity each call and permit legitimate atomic rename updates
implementation.writerPrecheck: recheck before lock rejects an already-replaced directory; no whole-transaction atomic write protection
implementation.absence: Only initial leaf lstat ENOENT yields empty/null, even after prior presence. No persistent leaf highwater; access errors/dangling links/disappearance during open or read fail
implementation.constructors: Original ensurePrivateDirectory remains; these constructors may create/secure their own directories and are not open-only installation readers
implementation.fsImpl: All reader and directory identity-helper operations forward to original supplied filesystem, preserving receiver and Windows projection bridge

remainingBoundaries: Sequential physical samples are not an atomic snapshot or general ABA defense; an independent backend may capture a new same-byte directory copy
No persistent mutable-leaf inode pin or detection of deletion across calls; no disk byte format/public descriptor/signature/CAS authority changes
Partial reads may request remaining ranges more than once; actual returned bytes and EOF probe, rather than sum of requested lengths, define this bound
Native Windows EPERM and WSL1 EACCES apply to the tested filesystems/runtime; they are not universal kernel/mount guarantees or ending-directory-check evidence
Synthetic precision/mode stat tests use real files/fds but do not demonstrate native NTFS Number-projection inode collisions or native mode replacement
Full actual journal/witness/segment/retention graph, installation endorsement, protected durable pins/highwater and forced business routes remain unfinished
No tenant-wide producer provenance, alias finalization, release lease/recovery admission, real paid A/B/C, statistical PASS or production promotion
WSL probes are targeted; no complete Linux Vitest/macOS/release workflow matrix executed
